text: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ((Shall I not inform you of what God erases sins and raises ranks with?)) They said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: Performing ablution thoroughly in times of difficulty, taking many steps to the mosques, and waiting for prayer after prayer, is that bond.
